details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Quadratic CPU use in schemaless container decoding
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-119194.patch: stop collecting component tag
       sets once two distinct types settle the SEQUENCE/SET guess
     - CVE-2026-119194
   * SECURITY UPDATE: Quadratic constructed OCTET STRING and ANY reassembly
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-119195.patch: collect fragments in a list and
       join them once instead of repeated bytes concatenation
     - CVE-2026-119195
   * SECURITY UPDATE: Quadratic constructed BIT STRING reassembly
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-119196.patch: pack fragment bits into one
       buffer instead of re-shifting the accumulated value per fragment
     - CVE-2026-119196
   * SECURITY UPDATE: Quadratic binary REAL mantissa decoding
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-119197.patch: convert the mantissa with a
       single from_bytes() call instead of a per-octet shift loop
     - CVE-2026-119197
